text: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival - Rockstar Games Pre-Load Now Pre-Load Now Skip the Menu Games - Sub Menu Newswire Videos Downloads Store External Support External Games - Sub Menu Newswire Videos Downloads Store External Support External Get Launcher Open Search Open Player Menu Open Player Menu Newswire Grand Theft Auto VI Announcements Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival November 21 at Mana Wynwood, Miami November 9, 2026 Experience the music of Vice City and Leonida at Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival , a special live event on November 21 at Mana Wynwood in Miami to celebrate the launch of GTAVI, featuring a star-studded lineup of artists from the game and the official soundtrack. Presented in partnership with PlayStation and produced by the creators of III Points, this is a one-of-a-kind launch event that features two stages of nonstop music. Performances include Cactus Jack presents Travis Scott, Don Toliver, Kodak Black, and Sofaygo; Cardi B; Ca7riel & Paco Amoroso; Justice (DJ set); Metro Boomin; Nick León B2B DJ Python; Prospa B2B Skream; Rauw & Friends; Suero; Tainy; The Dare B2B Fcukers (DJ set). To enter the pre-sale lottery for a chance to purchase tickets on Wednesday, November 11, make sure you have an active DICE account with up-to-date information and visit gtavi-thefestival.miami . Tickets are limited to two per pre-sale lottery code, and the lottery closes at 4 p.m. ET on Tuesday, November 10. For more information, visit rsg.ms/gtavi-thefestival . Also, check out the Music section of the official site to learn more about in-game radio stations, Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album , and the Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score — with links to listen, pre-save, and pre-order on vinyl and CD.
